summary: Kiley's record centers on defending Israel and supporting the IHRA definition in federal education law. He joined an AIPAC-organized House delegation to Israel in April 2024, publicly affirming Israel's right to defend itself, and in April 2025 praised Yale's crackdown on pro-Palestine encampments, framing the protests as anti-Israel. He voted Yea on H.R. 6090 and was listed as an original sponsor of H.R. 1007, both incorporating the IHRA definition into Title VI enforcement. Vote for Peace rated him Opposed.
